entities.name: Yusuf al-Mu'taman ibn Hud
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abu Amir Yusuf ibn Ahmad ibn Hud, more commonly known as al-Mu'taman, was a mathematician, and also one of the kings of the Taifa of Zaragoza. The name al-Mu'taman is itself a shortening of his full regnal name al-Mu'taman Billah.
